scientific_question: Resolve the remaining Enumeration/Native-thinking mechanism differences without changing the original V6 estimands or discovery-frozen banks.

global_firewall.reporting_rule: Distinguish exact preregistered replication, post-hoc geometry diagnostic, and descriptive extension.

index_targeted_city_support_audit.frozen_banks: selected discovery-frozen K plus the same three frozen random controls
index_targeted_city_support_audit.position_audit: Compare the registered query with the autoregressive predictor immediately before the first target-city token. If they coincide, record an exact alias rather than claiming an off-by-one error.
index_targeted_city_support_audit.new_primary_scope_definition: Ablate the frozen bank at every teacher-forced position from the registered query through the predictor of the final target-city token, inclusive.
index_targeted_city_support_audit.target: the unchanged fixed next-city token span
index_targeted_city_support_audit.strong_gate: Both seed-bootstrap 95% confidence-interval lower bounds exceed zero.
index_targeted_city_support_audit.qualification: Post-hoc temporal-support diagnostic on a previously inspected confirmation split; it cannot retroactively convert the original query-local null into a prospective pass.
index_targeted_city_support_audit.interpretation_guardrail: An explicit ordinal can externalize the address/progress cue, but it cannot provide the target city content. A null selected-bank result may reflect distributed retrieval, bank mismatch, or temporal-support mismatch; it is not evidence that city retrieval is unnecessary.

full_item_span_greedy_city_adoption.patch_geometry: endpoint-aligned full item span at the preselected single layer; unequal spans are left-cropped to the largest aligned complete support used by the existing registered kernel
full_item_span_greedy_city_adoption.qualification: Post-hoc behavioral readout extension on the existing confirmation cohort. The already frozen teacher-forced full-item-span effect is not rerun as a selection step.

bullet_gemma_query_through_carrier_repli.replication_kind: fresh prospective causal-outcome replication with an earlier discovery-frozen bank
bullet_gemma_query_through_carrier_repli.scope_definition: Every teacher-forced position from the registered final-transition query through the final grammar-carrier token, inclusive.
bullet_gemma_query_through_carrier_repli.eligibility: N=10 fresh_v6_parse.strict_causal_eligible is true and the source seed/request is unused by every earlier Gemma4-E4B enumeration_bullet V6 cohort registry supplied to the freezer
primary_endpoints: selected-mask specificity versus the mean of three frozen random masks
clean-carrier restoration of the selected-mask boundary deformation
bullet_gemma_query_through_carrier_repli.strong_gate: All three seed-bootstrap 95% confidence-interval lower bounds exceed zero.
bullet_gemma_query_through_carrier_repli.selection_disclosure: The bank was discovered earlier; only the causal intervention outcomes are prospectively fresh.
